title: 01. Foundations: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) vs Tree-of-Thought (ToT) in Agents
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompts the LLM to reason step-by-step in a linear sequence before producing an answer — each reasoning step builds on the previous one.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: **Chain-of-Thought (CoT)** prompts the LLM to reason step-by-step in a linear sequence before producing an answer — each reasoning step builds on the previous one. It's effective for arithmetic, multi-step logic, and structured problem-solving, and can be triggered with phrases like "Let's think step by step." **Tree-of-Thought (ToT)** extends this by allowing the LLM to explore **multiple reasoning branches** simultaneously, evaluate each branch, backtrack from dead ends, and select the best path — analogous to a tree search algorithm (BFS or DFS) over thought space. In agent systems, CoT is used within individual reasoning steps (cheap, single-pass), while ToT is used for complex planning problems where the first reasoning path may fail. ToT significantly increases token cost (N branches × branch depth) but produces substantially better results on hard planning and reasoning tasks.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT vs TREE-OF-THOUGHT
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT (Linear):
───────────────────────────
Problem
   │
   ▼
Step 1 ──► Step 2 ──► Step 3 ──► Answer
(Single path, builds sequentially)

Cost: O(depth) LLM calls
Failure: Gets stuck if Step 1 direction is wrong

TREE-OF-THOUGHT (Branching):
──────────────────────────────
              Problem
                 │
        ┌────────┼────────┐
        ▼        ▼        ▼
      Path A   Path B   Path C   ← Generate N thoughts
     (score:   (score:  (score:
      0.3)      0.8)     0.5)
        │        │        │
       ✗       ┌┴┐       ✗       ← Score & prune
            B1   B2
           (0.7) (0.9)
                  │
                 B2-1
                  │
               ANSWER              ← Best path wins

Cost: O(N^depth) LLM calls — EXPENSIVE
Benefit: Explores multiple approaches, backtracks from dead ends

HYBRID IN AGENTS:
──────────────────
[Simple Steps] ──► CoT (cheap, fast)
[Complex Planning] ──► ToT (expensive, accurate)
[Production] ──► CoT with ToT fallback if confidence < 0.6
```
